### submission MTA

*  "submission servers" --- special case of SMTP "relays"
*  mail user agent sends message to one submission server, then forgets about it
   *  uses same protocol as sending to "real" servers
*  simplifies logic of mail user agents
   *  no handling retrying, finding correct mail server etc.
*  often uses different port numbers than "normal" SMTP
   *  normal SMTP: port 25 (unencrypted/STARTTLS)
   *  "submission" SMTP: port 587 (unencrypted/STARTTLS), port 465 (TLS)
